description: Source code for column display and formatting functions in a Git-related project, including layout calculations, display routines, and external command integration.

methods.name: item_length
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string in UTF-8 characters, stripping ANSI escapes.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Calculates the number of rows and columns for table display based on available width and padding.

methods.name: compute_column_width
methods.description: Determines the maximum width for each column based on cell contents.

methods.name: shrink_columns
methods.description: Reduces column widths by decreasing rows and increasing columns to fit within total width.

methods.name: display_plain
methods.description: Displays list items without layout, with indentation and newline.

methods.name: display_cell
methods.description: Prints a single cell with proper spacing and line breaks.

methods.name: display_table
methods.description: Displays a list as a formatted table with columns and rows.

methods.name: print_columns
methods.description: Main entry point for printing a list in column format based on options.

methods.name: finalize_colopts
methods.description: Adjusts column options based on whether output is a TTY or pager is in use.

methods.name: parse_option
methods.description: Parses individual column layout or enable/disable options.

methods.name: parse_config
methods.description: Parses a string of options to configure column display.

methods.name: column_config
methods.description: Configures column options based on configuration variables.

methods.name: git_column_config
methods.description: Handles configuration for column options with specific prefixes.

methods.name: parseopt_column_callback
methods.description: Callback for command-line options to set column options.

methods.name: run_column_filter
methods.description: Starts an external 'column' command process for filtering output.
